reason: A local Git change analyzer that reports release risks, discovers project quality checks, and optionally runs explicitly authorized checks or enforces an opt-in pre-commit gate.

summaries.zh: 用于扫描本地 Git 变更、识别发布风险、发现项目质量检查并生成报告的发布审查工具。
summaries.en: A release review tool that scans local Git changes for risks, discovers project quality checks, and generates reports.

capabilities: Reads local Git changes, configuration, and manifest files
Applies deterministic release-risk rules to changed-file metadata and added lines
Discovers test, typecheck, and build commands
Produces human-readable and versioned JSON reports
Can execute explicitly authorized configured project-check commands with the invoking user's permissions
Can optionally install a pre-commit gate that denies commits on a blocking verdict
